content: This study reviewed state-of-the-art approaches and systems of Vietnamese word segmentation. The review pointed out common features and methods used in Vietnamese word segmentation studies. This study also had an evaluation of the existing Vietnamese word segmentation toolkits based on a same corpus to show advantages and disadvantages as to shed some lights on system enhancement.
